question: Related Questions Q. Zakat on land 1771 views Q. Can zakaat be given to a child whose parents are not muslims? I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 3464 Country: India Title: kaya saiyed ko zakat de sakte hain Mufti mehdi hasan (R.A) & mufti Saeed ka kya khayal hai Question: kaya saiyed ko zakat de sakte hain Mufti mehdi hasan (R.A) & mufti Saeed ka kya khayal hai Answer ID: 3464 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 231/231=L) It is unlawful to give zakah to a syed (member of the Prophet?s family صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ): ولا الی بنی ھاشم ( الدر المختار مع الشامی: 3/299 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
